identitySignals: Agenda title is a COVID-19 testing services agreement; Curative is a company that ran large-scale COVID-19 testing in California and wound down testing in 2022 (Wikipedia)

Search results indicate a separate entity named Curative Labs Inc. exists (Delaware, 2021, formerly KorvaLabs), but no registry page was fetched to confirm it, and Curative's own site names only 'Curative, Inc.'
Agenda gives no city, and Curative's current website and contact details describe its health insurance business, not the testing lab, so the exact contracting entity could not be confirmed
research.notes: Not publishable. Could not confirm that the contracting entity 'Curative Labs, Inc.' (a testing-lab subsidiary) is the same as Curative, Inc., whose website now covers health insurance. Registry pages (CA SOS, SAM.gov) were not retrieved. Contact details on curative.com are health-plan member support lines, so they were not used.

profile.summary: Curative is a privately held company based in Austin, Texas. It began in 2020 by developing COVID-19 tests and ran large-scale COVID-19 testing and vaccination sites until it wound down testing in 2022. It now sells employer-sponsored health insurance plans.
